findings.description: Eligibility includes households living in dilapidated houses, which is stated in the Objective but not captured in the inclusion predicates.
findings.source_quote: PMAY-G aims to provide pucca (permanent) houses with basic amenities to all rural houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, using Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data and the Awaas+ (2018) survey, verified by Gram Sabhas.
